title: Train-source feasibility screen for range-time echo Betti curves

candidate.name: per-sample normalized upper-level-set Betti curves
candidate.mechanism: track 4-connected echo components and enclosed 4-connected holes across fixed upper-tail intensity quantiles; this describes persistence of connected scattering patterns across thresholds, not hand kinematics
candidate.scope: single-view classifiers reported separately for Left, Top, Right; no view selection or fusion

prior_art_boundary.same_corpus: Xue et al., Frontiers in Neuroscience 20 (2026), 1864448, DOI 10.3389/fnins.2026.1864448, uses the same 12-class, 8-subject, three-X4-view UWB-Gestures corpus and 90x189 MTI maps; it reports early tri-view fusion, local/global backbones, and adaptive bilinear fusion, but no topological descriptor in the reviewed full text.
prior_art_boundary.radar_topology: Blumenstein et al., Sensors 23(4), 2224 (2023), DOI 10.3390/s23042224, applies persistent homology to 60-GHz OTFS delay-Doppler maps for human-presence/target-peak detection against CFAR, not gesture classification.
prior_art_boundary.screen_scope: bounded targeted primary-source search, not an exhaustive novelty search; PH itself is established and this pilot cannot establish algorithmic novelty

data_and_split.held_out_unit: one source participant at a time (six internal development folds)
data_and_split.participants_7_8: do not read their gesture labels, fit on them, score them, or use them for selection
data_and_split.quality_exclusions: exclude participant 2 zero-based classes 10/11 and participant 6 zero-based class 3, matching the archived quality rule; for source participants 1-6, assert retained counts 1200,1000,1200,1200,1200,1107 (6907 total), otherwise abort before fit
data_and_split.caveat: all eight participants have prior project-development exposure; this is an exploratory feasibility screen, not independent validation

frozen_transform.map: absolute-valued map, non-overlapping 3x3 max pooling to 30x63, then divide by per-map mean plus 1e-8
frozen_transform.topology: at each quantile threshold, compute beta0 with 4-connectivity and beta1 as enclosed background components using the dual 8-connectivity; feature is log1p(beta0,beta1) concatenated over thresholds
frozen_transform.amplitude_control: nine fixed quantile values of the same normalized map (spatial-layout-free)
frozen_transform.spatial_null: same topology descriptor after one fixed, seeded permutation of the 30x63 pixels per view; preserves each map's intensity multiset but disrupts local range-time adjacency
frozen_transform.model: StandardScaler fitted on training-source records only, then sklearn RidgeClassifier(alpha=1.0); no hyperparameter search, no CNN

evaluation.primary_metric: macro recall over classes present for each held-out source participant, averaged equally across six participants and three views
evaluation.go_rule: topology minus amplitude-control >= 0.010 absolute macro recall; positive in at least 4/6 source participants for at least 2/3 views; no view mean below -0.010; and topology exceeds spatial-null by >=0.010 overall
evaluation.interpretation: GO only permits designing a separate frozen outer-user validation; it is not evidence of a contribution. Any other outcome closes this descriptor without retuning thresholds, connectivity, view, classifier, or seed.

budget.budget_exhaustion: mark incomplete; never interpret as a scientific negative

artifacts: protocol and code SHA-256 before any source map/label value read

environment receipt, participant/sample IDs for source folds only, feature matrices, fold scalers and ridge coefficients, predictions, per-user/per-view metrics, timing/budget receipt, and failure state
all bulky arrays and model artifacts stay in cloud workspace, not Git
stop_conditions: any audit participant label is accessed
any test/audit user used for fitting, standardization, choice, or selection
